messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Corticosteroid medication can affect growth in children. Talk with your doctor if you think your child is not growing at a normal rate while using this medicine.
Triplet: ["corticosteroid medication", "affects", "growth in children"]

The relation 'affects' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity can influence or have an effect on the condition or process specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'affected by': The subject entity is influenced or altered by the factor specified by the object entity.

C. 'may cause': The subject action or condition can lead to or contribute to the development of the medical condition or effect specified by the object entity.
D. 'is a type of': The subject entity is a specific type or subtype of the object entity.
E. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
